## 🧑‍💻 About

CSE student at **SRMIST** who likes taking problems that don't have clean answers yet and building something that works.

My interests sit at the intersection of **distributed systems, agentic AI, and edge/offline-first architectures** — areas where there's still genuinely hard, unsolved work.

> I'm still learning. But I learn fastest by building things that are *slightly beyond what I already know.*

## 🚀 Featured Builds

**⚡ Distributed Rate Limiter & Load Balancer**

High-throughput request management built from scratch — consistent hashing, token bucket algorithm, distributed state across nodes.

`Python` · `AWS` · `SQL` &nbsp;|&nbsp; `consistent hashing` · `token bucket` · `distributed state` · `load balancing`

<br/>

**🤖 FieldMind**

Offline-first AI inspection platform that runs where the internet doesn't. Learns locally, syncs intelligently, makes decisions on-device.

`Python` · `TensorFlow Lite` · `Edge AI` &nbsp;|&nbsp; `on-device inference` · `P2P sync` · `CRDTs` · `active learning`

<br/>

**💉 VVM Vision**

Vaccine supply-chain intelligence — VVM image reading, heat-budget tracking, and route optimization for cold-chain reliability.

`Python` · `Computer Vision` · `Optimization` &nbsp;|&nbsp; `VVM detection` · `heat-aware routing` · `GPS checkpoints` · `traceability`

<br/>

**🛡️ AI Financial Guardian**

Agentic payment workflow built around one question: *should this payment happen this way at all?*

`Agentic AI` · `Browser Automation` · `LLMs` &nbsp;|&nbsp; `subscription intelligence` · `payment readiness` · `plan comparison`
